description: This file defines the CachedCatalogItemServiceDecorator class, which implements ICatalogItemService and adds caching functionality to catalog item operations using local storage. It manages retrieving, caching, and updating catalog items with local storage support.

classes.name: CachedCatalogItemServiceDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class that adds caching behavior to ICatalogItemService implementations, using local storage to cache catalog items and reduce backend calls.

methods.name: ListPaged
methods.description: Retrieves a paged list of catalog items, either from cache or from the backend if cache is stale.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Retrieves the full list of catalog items, either from cache or from the backend if cache is stale.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Gets a specific CatalogItem by ID, using the cached list.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new CatalogItem and refreshes the local storage cache.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Edits an existing CatalogItem and refreshes the local storage cache.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a CatalogItem by ID and refreshes the local storage cache.

methods.name: RefreshLocalStorageList
methods.description: Refreshes the cache in local storage with the latest list of CatalogItems from the backend.
